Job gaps.
Corporate America’s favorite imaginary crime.

Apparently if you’re unemployed for 6 months, your skills evaporate, your memory resets, and you forget how to open Excel. Amazing.
In this episode of Taboo Resume Advice, we talk about how hiring systems treat job gaps like a felony… and what you can actually do about it.

Because here’s the reality:
People don’t stop being good workers just because they got laid off, escaped a toxic job, tried something new, or got trapped in the hiring black hole.
But the ATS robot doesn’t
